ios.desc:
Write what you're feeling. The app reads your own words back and names the emotions it finds. Give it a few weeks and the patterns are easier to spot.

Nothing gets shared. There is no feed, and there are no followers.

Tap + and write. When you save, the entry is tagged with the emotions found in your own language. Analytics gathers those tags over 7, 30, or 90 days and shows the words you reach for most.

Vents stay on your device. Cloud Backup is optional in Settings if you want to move them to another phone. To delete one, press and hold the vent, then tap the trash icon.

MOM AI PRO
Your first 100 entries are free, and nothing is locked while you write them: From Mom and On your mind included. After that, Pro is a monthly subscription that starts with a free week if you haven't had one before. It renews until you cancel in your Apple ID settings. Reading what you've already written stays free.
